headline: On last trading day, Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty reclaimed 25,000 led by banking and pharmaceutical stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Strong performance in banking and pharmaceutical stocks led the gains
A correction in global oil prices supported Indian equity markets
Positive global cues followed a tech surge in US markets
Banking stocks played catch-up to drive the Nifty's recovery
whatHappening: NSE and BSE are closed today for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday
Sensex and Nifty reached their highest levels in over eight months during the last session
The Nifty 50 reclaimed the 25,000 psychological level as bank stocks rallied
Data Patterns shares rose 9% as the Sensex ended 107 points higher on Monday
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada. In the last session, the Nifty reclaimed the 25,000 level while the Sensex surpassed 81,000. Gains were driven by strong performance in banking and pharmaceutical stocks alongside global tech rallies.
